mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP is increasing, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP indicates a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies are increasing, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the labor market is weakening, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPI is increasing, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
